runner: evals/run-evals.sh builds each eval's scratch folder under $TMPDIR, runs claude -p in it with the skill (with_prompt, plugin loaded from this repo) and without it (prompt, no plugin), then grades the folder with evals/check.sh <kind>. A gh guard on PATH and --disallowedTools block every GitHub write; check.sh confirms no repo was created.
prompt: Turn this folder into a new project using Dom's standards from the dominicfarr/dev-standards GitHub repo, up to and including a first commit that passes the installed hooks. Do not create a GitHub repo or labels.

evals.name: empty-folder
evals.fixture: An empty folder with a fresh name (np-eval-<random>) that no GitHub repo has.
evals.expected_output: The folder is a git repo on main with one commit holding the seven standard files (each with a source header naming a real dev-standards commit), CLAUDE.md with the Read first line above ## Agent skills, docs/agents/*, a README, and pre-commit and commit-msg hooks installed.

assertions.text: Every standard file is present, its first line is a source header in the file's comment syntax naming a real dev-standards commit, and the rest of the file matches dev-standards at that commit

CLAUDE.md has the Read first line above ## Agent skills, with GitHub issue tracker, triage labels and single-context domain docs sub-blocks, and docs/agents/ holds issue-tracker.md, triage-labels.md and domain.md
pre-commit's hooks are installed for both the pre-commit and commit-msg stages
Branch main has exactly one commit, the working tree is clean, and the commit passes the hooks (pre-commit on its files and commitlint on its message)
No GitHub repo dominicfarr/<folder name> exists and the repo has no remote

evals.name: idea-note-folder
evals.fixture: A fresh folder holding only IDEA.md, a short idea note.
evals.expected_output: Same as empty-folder, and IDEA.md is unchanged and part of the first commit.

assertions.text: IDEA.md is byte-for-byte the original note and is in the first commit

evals.name: refuse-git-history
evals.fixture: A fresh folder that is already a git repo with one commit (notes.md).
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses: history, files and hooks are untouched.

assertions.text: HEAD is still the original commit and it is the only commit
No standard file, CLAUDE.md or docs/agents/ was written, the working tree is clean, and no pre-commit hook was installed
No GitHub repo dominicfarr/<folder name> exists

evals.name: refuse-taken-repo-name
evals.fixture: An empty folder named claude-skill-lab, a repo dominicfarr already owns.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses before git init: the folder stays empty.

assertions.text: The folder is still empty: no .git, no files
